name: variants-from-load-expansion
body: Enum `variants_from` expansion, worked. A template's `enum` field that declares `variants_from:` names a glob relative to the root of the library layer that owns the template (e.g. `media/bgs/*.jpg`); while the layer loads, the loader expands that glob against the layer's own root and replaces the field's value set with the matching files' paths relative to the layer's `media/` tree (e.g. `bgs/right-8.jpg`), sorted. A glob that matches no file under the layer's `media/` tree, and a field that declares both `variants:` and `variants_from:`, are templates errors reported with the offending `template.yaml` path. Because the glob is resolved against the layer's own root, an external layer's glob resolves within the external library alone, preserving library self-containment (external-library-self-contained, global.constraint.template-library-shareable).
